utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right? Teams is showing about three different microphones.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, you're clear. Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The blue one? Brave parking it under that tree.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. It'll have a different finish by lunchtime.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Actual cake, not another packet of biscuits with a candle.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Finally, some useful operational information.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the catering meeting. It's Friday, 21 August. What's already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the HV board last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Completely finished, yeah? Not sitting there waiting for the last bit?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Completely. Nothing left over from that repair for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And I signed off the inspection on the trucks on Tuesday, so that's old business as well.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same with the AC1. I already swapped the filter on the AC1 yesterday. That old line on the list is finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Those are completed items, not fresh jobs.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: One observation from nights: noticed the air dryer was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So a warm spell, rather than something that's still happening?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Settled down. Just passing on what I saw, not asking for work on it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on observations, I heard a slight rattle from the line 3 chiller. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing definite enough to call a fault, then?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No. Just a slight rattle. Not raising another job off that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. The spare parts order is separate from that noise, just so we don't muddle them up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll order spare parts for the line 3 chiller today at 2pm. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's staying with Sarah Okafor, then, rather than dropping into my buying list?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, with me. I'll place the order today at 2pm; no need to turn it into an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, understood. I won't duplicate the order.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On the subject of parts, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT1 fuel valve. Still blocked on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. That's a blocked status update, not another chase we're allocating this morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Correct. Still no confirmed delivery, that's all I've got.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, um, the sensor calibration itself, rather than treating that warm spell as a new fault?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer. That's the top-priority job; the nights observation is separate.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: My blocked one hasn't changed either. Can't get to the IM1 hydraulic unit until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. No window, no access. We're not treating that as a job to start today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Just making the restriction clear, not promising anything on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you chase the purchase order for the CT1 on Friday, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On Friday as in today, yeah? Not next Friday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today, Friday. Just the CT1 purchase order, if you've got a spare minute. It's low priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the CT1 on Friday, today. Understood, spare-minute job.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Purchase order, not a delivery confirmation. Those two keep getting mixed together in conversation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Right, the sign-off next.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, so Saturday morning? Just checking I've heard that properly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Saturday. Tomorrow at 9:30 for the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Clear. I heard tomorrow as well, before anyone blames the headset.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll schedule downtime for the GT2 Number 2 Bearing with production next week.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's agreeing the downtime with them next week, not saying the bearing work itself is definitely next week?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. I'll do the scheduling with production next week. We're not agreeing a bearing-work date on this call.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, scheduling sits with Sarah Okafor. No assumed strip-down date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Then there's the contractor booking for the turbine one. We need that booking made this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you book a contractor to look at the turbine one this morning?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that booking on this morning. I haven't got the availability for it. The little CT1 chase is one thing, but I can't commit to this as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough, better to say now. I'll hand that one over.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you take it instead and book a contractor to look at the turbine one this morning?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that from Davey. I'll book a contractor to look at the turbine one this morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers, Grace. That's off me and with you, then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, before we finish—we were going to replace the belt on the MV01, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, the belt replacement isn't on today's work. That's the old plan?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, old plan. Deferred to next month, nothing to pick up today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And to keep the order of importance clear, the Compressed Air Dryer sensor recalibration is top priority. Not the spare parts order or the purchase-order chase.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, clear. I've got the recalibration.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the cake remains an observation, not an assigned action?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Definitely no owner or completion target for the cake. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
